stories.title: PM Shehbaz chairs apex committee meeting in Peshawar; to review security situation in KP
stories.brief: The Centre imposed emergency and governor’s rule in KP on October 11, citing the PTI-led provincial government’s “deliberate disengagement” from the fight against terrorism. Governor Kundi, along with Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi, chaired a meeting of the apex committee a day after governor’s rule was imposed.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz arrives in Peshawar for apex committee meeting, security briefing
stories.brief: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif arrived in Peshawar on Thursday to attend an apex committee meeting on the law and order situation in Khyber-Pakhtunkhwa (K-P), with a major development package for the province also expected to be announced during his visit, sources said.

stories.title: Why is a peat fire so bad? BBC is in Indonesia to find out

stories.title: IMF forecasts 1.3% contraction in Pakistan, 6.6% growth in 2027
stories.brief: The International Monetary Fund said the region's output was expected to contract by 1.3% as a result of the war's ​impact on energy production, shipping, tourism, trade and confidence.

stories.title: Govt, JI negotiating committees to meet over petroleum levy tomorrow
stories.brief: The government and Jamaat-e-Islami (JI) negotiating committees are set to meet in Islamabad on Friday to discuss the abolition of the petroleum levy, as the party prepares to resume nationwide protests over fuel prices, JI Deputy Emir Liaquat Baloch said on Thursday.

stories.title: Islamabad LG polls set for Dec 20
stories.brief: Local government elections in the federal capital will be held on December 20, the Election Commission of Pakistan (ECP) announced on Tuesday, issuing the election schedule along with strict instructions to ensure a transparent and impartial electoral process.

stories.title: PTI lawmakers back talks to restore K-P govt
stories.brief: The PTI parliamentary party held an online meeting on Wednesday to discuss the situation following the imposition of governor's rule and emergency measures. Dogar also maintained that Sohail Afridi was the party's constitutional and lawful chief minister in K-P and enjoyed Khan's confidence.
